blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The southernmost municipality of Bulalacao in Oriental Mindoro is strengthening border monitoring and biosecurity defenses to protect and maintain its African Swine Fever (ASF)-free status after Occidental Mindoro had its first ASF case last week. The move aligns with the Oriental Mindoro provincial government’s broader preventive action, which includes establishing Animal Quarantine Checkpoints (AQC) at strategic boundary points — including the entry at Sitio Cambayang, Barangay Cabugao in Bulalacao, which links to Magsaysay town in Occidental Mindoro. Local authorities are intensifying inspections at all entry points, screening persons, livestock shipments, and meat products entering the town […]...
